capabilities.description: Record a guest check-in by capturing the guest name, room number, and check-in timestamp, and persist it to the check-in log for the current day.
Display a list of all check-ins recorded today, showing guest name, room number, and check-in time in a simple, readable view for front-desk staff.

summary: A minimal front-desk tool for small hotels that lets staff record guest check-ins and view a list of today's check-ins. It serves front-desk clerks and managers who need a simple, reliable daily log without any additional property-management features.
